name: Vesmo Elektromotory a.s.

payment_behaviour.note: last 12m: 20 of 45 invoices paid >3 days late, max 7 days. Pays slightly late (avg 2.9 days); minor irritant only.

financial_health.signal: Stable group, credit 173 unchanged; no distress.

notes: Increase asks avg 3.8%, settled ~1.3% (gap 2.5 pp); 2026 renewals settled +1.2% (EV-2026-70520-350010, EV-2026-70520-350012).

situation: Czech motor maker (EUR 192 m, we are 1.15% - our biggest relative weight in electrical). Copper is bought forward until March 2027, so it quotes 2027 prices FLAT (4 kW EUR 225.61, 15 kW EUR 601.27, valid 90 days) and calls copper market moves 'not our reality'. It is reviewing small accounts and wants volume. Delivery and quality are slipping (OTD 81.1%, 764 ppm in 2026Q3, one open QN). Cheaper than Nordmark on the 4 kW (225.61 vs 239.21) where it only holds 30%.

pressures.evidence: Reviewing small accounts, focusing on customers with volume.
OTD fell to 81.1% and ppm rose to 764 in 2026Q3; qn:20004999 still open.
Copper hedged to March 2027: costs fixed, market index irrelevant to them until then.

what_it_values: volume share (wants to be a 'customer with volume')
price stability through the hedge window
